_note: The ?svc= hero variants for design/marketing/CAD Drafting.dc.html's `svcMap` (L208-233). The site nav deep-links every service in the mega-menu to /services/cad-drafting?svc=<slug>, and the param swaps exactly four hero strings — breadcrumb label, badge pill, h1 and subhead — while every section below the hero stays the shared drafting content. Each state is one Persona row on the cad-drafting scope in group 'service-variant', the only block with five independent text fields to hold them: kicker = the svc slug the URL matches on, title = the h1, body = the subhead, cta_label = the badge pill, cta_href = the breadcrumb label. The design's `heroDefault` is not repeated here — it is already the page's own breadcrumb_current / hero_eyebrow / hero_h1 / hero_sub copy rows, which the route falls back to when svc is absent or unrecognised, so the default hero keeps a single home the owner edits. The `delete` block removes three orphaned pricing personas: an earlier revision of seeds/patches/cad-drafting.json seeded them ungrouped and with no price, and re-seeding them into group 'pricing' left the ungrouped copies behind, doubling the pricing section.

personas.title: Talk it through with a pro, on video
personas.body: Book a live video consult with a licensed architect or drafter to pressure-test your idea, scope, and budget before any drawings begin.

personas.title: A second set of eyes on your plans
personas.body: Send us your existing drawings and get a marked-up, prioritized review — catch problems before they reach a plan checker.

personas.title: Find out if it can be built
personas.body: A focused feasibility check against zoning, setbacks, and code so you know what your site allows before you invest in a full set.

personas.title: Document what already exists
personas.body: Measured, coordinated as-built drawings of an existing home or space — the standard starting point for any remodel or addition.

personas.title: Turn flat PDFs into editable CAD
personas.body: Legacy PDFs and scans rebuilt as clean, layered, editable CAD you can keep working in — priced per sheet.

personas.title: Capture a space to the millimeter
personas.body: On-site 3D laser scanning produces a precise point cloud of existing conditions — the reliable base for as-builts and renovations.

personas.title: From point cloud to a working model
personas.body: We convert laser-scan point clouds into an accurate, parametric BIM model your whole team can build on.

personas.title: Title-24 & energy compliance, done right
personas.body: Energy calculations and compliance documentation prepared correctly the first time, so your submittal clears plan check without correction cycles.

personas.title: Get your structure stamped
personas.body: A licensed structural engineer reviews and stamps your framing and lateral design so it is permit-ready in your jurisdiction.

personas.title: Navigate the code with an expert
personas.body: Hourly code consulting to untangle occupancy, egress, fire, and accessibility requirements before they become correction notices.

personas.title: A complete, permit-ready drawing set
personas.body: Everything a plan checker expects — coordinated plans, sections, and details assembled into a submittal-ready permit set.

personas.title: Know exactly what your site allows
personas.body: A zoning study of setbacks, height, coverage, and use so you design within the envelope from day one.

personas.title: A designed interior, drawn to build
personas.body: Finishes, layouts, and specifications pulled together into a coordinated interior package your contractor can price and build.

personas.title: Stage a space before it exists
personas.body: Photoreal virtual staging that furnishes empty or in-progress rooms — perfect for listings, approvals, and buy-in.

personas.title: Plan every piece that fills the space
personas.body: A complete furniture and FF&E plan with layouts, schedules, and specifications ready for procurement.
